_comment_finding: Finding #05: COOP/COEP Configured Only in Report-Only Mode
_comment_what_was_wrong: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy were deployed exclusively as '-Report-Only' headers. While useful for telemetry during rollout, they provide zero runtime isolation against Spectre/cross-origin window referencing attacks.
_comment_what_this_fix_does: Transitions COOP to 'same-origin' and COEP to 'require-corp' (or 'credentialless') enforcing cross-origin isolation in production. Note: Verify CSP report metrics before switching to prevent breaking embedded third-party widgets without CORP headers.
